about_the_game: BUZZ WARS is an upcoming bee and wasp themed strategy/fighting game with multiplayer support. Build hives tactically, control your units with pheromones, raid enemy hives or swap into first person mode to fight the enemy. The demo contains all but 2 playable units and 2 playable maps.
